html:
{{ letter_head }}
Exit Interview Form
{% macro yn(value, opt) -%} {{ "☑" if value == opt else "☐" }}{{ opt }} {%- endmacro %}
Section A: Employee Information
Employee Name: {{ frappe.db.get_value("Employee", doc.employee, "employee_name") or "" }} Last Working Day: {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.last_working_day) if doc.last_working_day else "" }}
Position/Department: {{ doc.department or "" }} Interview Date: {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.interview_date) if doc.interview_date else "" }}
Date of Hire: {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.date_of_hiring) if doc.date_of_hiring else "" }} Interview Conducted By: {{ doc.interview_conducted_by or "" }}
Section B: Reason for Leaving
  • {{ "☑" if doc.voluntary_resignation else "☐" }}Voluntary resignation: {{ doc.voluntary_resignation or "" }}
  • {{ "☑" if doc.end_of_contract == "Yes" else "☐" }}End of contract
  • {{ "☑" if doc.other_specify else "☐" }}Other (specify): {{ doc.other_specify or "" }}
  • {{ yn(doc.termination, "Yes") }}{{ yn(doc.termination, "No") }} Termination
  • {{ yn(doc.retirement, "Yes") }}{{ yn(doc.retirement, "No") }} Retirement
Please explain the main reason for leaving:
{{ doc.please_explain_the_main_reason_for_leaving or "" }}
Section C: Work Experience Section D: Training & Development
1. Job Role & Responsibilities
Were your duties clearly defined? {{ yn(doc.were_your_duties_clearly_defined, "Yes") }} {{ yn(doc.were_your_duties_clearly_defined, "No") }}
Comments:
{{ doc.comment or "" }}

2. Work Environment
How would you describe the workplace culture?
{{ doc.how_would_you_describe_the_workplace_culture or "" }}
What factors helped or hindered your performance?
{{ doc.what_factors_helped_or_hindered_your_performance or "" }}

3. Management & Supervision
Did you receive adequate support from your supervisor? ☐Yes ☐No
Examples:
 
Did you receive sufficient training for your role? {{ yn(doc.did_you_receive_sufficient_training_for_your_role, "Yes") }} {{ yn(doc.did_you_receive_sufficient_training_for_your_role, "No") }}
What additional training would have helped?
{{ doc.what_additional_training_would_have_helped or "" }}

Section E: Compensation & Benefits
Were you satisfied with salary and benefits? {{ yn(doc.were_you_satisfied_with_salary_and_benefits, "Yes") }} {{ yn(doc.were_you_satisfied_with_salary_and_benefits, "No") }}
If not, why?
{{ doc.if_yes_why or "" }}
Section F: Suggestions for Improvement Section G: Final Comments
What changes would you recommend for improving the workplace?
{{ doc.what_changes_would_you_recommend_for_improving_the_workplace or "" }}
Would you consider rejoining the organization in the future? {{ yn(doc.would_you_consider_rejoining_the_organization_in_the_future, "Yes") }} {{ yn(doc.would_you_consider_rejoining_the_organization_in_the_future, "No") }}
Any additional remarks:
{{ doc.any_additional_remarks or "" }}
Section H: Signatures
Employee:   Date:  {{frappe.utils.today()}}
HR/Interviewer:   Date:  {{frappe.utils.today()}}
name: Exit Interview Form
